claim: The recorded 100% accuracy is only 5 limit-selected items out of 2,376 (0.21%), so it does not estimate full ARC Easy accuracy.
limitations: This limits interpretation of the supplied run, not the full benchmark when run over all items.

claim: Source targets align with displayed answer positions for all 2,376 pinned test records; all five logged prompts, choices and targets exactly match their pinned records.
limitations: Ground-truth science correctness was not independently adjudicated for all 2,376 questions.

claim: No direct answer leakage appears in the five recorded attempts: model-visible messages contain questions, choices and format instructions, while targets remain hidden; there are no tools or sandbox.

evidence.location: messages and target for all five samples

limitations: Five transcripts cannot rule out memorisation of this public dataset or defects elsewhere in the population.

claim: The solver rejects semantically clear bare-letter or prose answers unless they include an ANSWER: marker, so scores partly measure format compliance despite an explicit format instruction.
limitations: The prompt explicitly requires the accepted format, and all five recorded responses complied, so no observed score changed.

claim: Five exact question pairs create five redundant observations among 2,376 test records (0.21% excess records).
limitations: Duplicate wording may have different choices; this check identifies exact questions, not semantic near-duplicates.
